title: Hussain ka Arbeen Hoga
body:
ya hussain ya hussain
hussain (a.s) ka aarbeen hoga (2)
he har zaba par aahayi tarana (2)
hussain (a.s) ka aarbeen hoga (2)
1) najaf ki wafi se karbala tak
nagar nagar me gali gali me
lage gi fir se sabil maula (2)
2) hussain ke ishq me karado
zawar padail safar karege
jo chaye karna ho karle duniya (2)
3) qadam qadam par hussain ko
hajaro hajj ka savab de kar
bahayage rab karam ka dariya (2)
4) kahi pe majlish kahi pe matam
kahi pe giraya kahi pe nauha
aza me rang jayega zamana (2)
5) hussaini mehhma ke paav kandhe
pe rakh ke khidmat karege khadim
khuda salamat rakh ye jazba (2)
6) zamana walo se ja ke kehdo
hussaini yo ko waba se dar kya
hei gayab me jab bachana wala (2)
7) abhi se nasle yaazidi yo ko
ye bat behad sata rahi hei
bata raha hei aadu ka chara (2)
8) zamane bhar me aza ke dushman
bohat hei rizwan or asgar
ye kha ke munkir ka dil jalana (2)
hussain (a.s) ka aarbeen hoga (2)
he har zaba par aahayi tarana (2)
hussain (a.s) ka aarbeen hoga (2)
